lines.en: label rinspring4:
scene clearnightsky
It was a hot January night in spring.
lines.zh: 那是春天里一个燥热的一月之夜。

lines.en: Yeah, I know.
lines.zh: 嗯，我知道。

lines.en: I promise, things will get better though. This isn’t one of those events that begins with some sort of transient, melancholic monologue you’d need to lobotomize yourself to understand.
lines.zh: 不过我保证，情况会好起来的。这可不是那种开头先来一段转瞬即逝、伤感兮兮的独白，你得先给自己做个脑叶切除才看得懂的事件。

lines.en: This is one of the {i}good{/i} nights.
lines.zh: 这是个{i}好{/i}夜晚。

lines.en: The kind that you look back on and think, “Huh...I guess there {i}was{/i} a time when I was truly happy.”
lines.zh: 就是那种你回望时会想「嗯……原来我也{i}曾有过{/i}真正快乐的时候」的夜晚。

lines.en: Because, maybe it’s just me, but you stop forming those memories once you get a little older.
lines.zh: 因为——也许只是我这么觉得——人稍微上了点年纪，就不再制造那种记忆了。

lines.en: So those moments you spent with your friends back when your hands were smaller sort of linger there forever — eternally locked in the closet of your mind, opened only when you’re looking for an old shirt or keys or-
lines.zh: 所以那些手还小小的年月里、和朋友一起度过的瞬间，就会永远地留在那儿——永远锁在你脑海深处的柜子里，只有当你翻找一件旧衬衫、一串钥匙或者——的时候才会被打开。

lines.en: Sorry. I’ll stop. I promised this wouldn’t get melancholic and I intend to keep my word despite the many other times in which I’ve deceived you.
lines.zh: 抱歉。我打住。我答应过这不会变得伤感，尽管我骗过你那么多次，这次我打算说到做到。

lines.en: That backstory goes like this — a pipe burst on the 56th floor of the infinite dorm building. Everything flooded.
lines.zh: 这段前情提要大致是这样的——无限宿舍大楼的 56 层爆了一根水管。全淹了。

lines.en: scene dndbath1

And, not wanting to bathe alongside their cherished possessions and anything that may have floated out of the abyss that is dorm seven, a handful of the girls from Class 1-A decided to come bathe {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: 于是，1-A 班的几个姑娘不想跟自己心爱的家当、以及任何可能从七号宿舍那个深渊里漂出来的东西一起泡澡，便决定来{i}这儿{/i}洗。

lines.en: A certain someone was not very happy about this.
lines.zh: 有个人对此相当不高兴。

lines.en: : I do not like this at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点也不喜欢这样。

lines.en: That certain someone was Io Ichimonji. Everyone else was fine, though.
lines.zh: 那个不高兴的人就是 Io Ichimonji。不过其他人都无所谓。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, we won’t bother you. There’s no one in the men’s bath right now, is there? I’d like to rent out the whole section for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 别担心，我们不会打扰你的。男汤那边现在没人吧？我想把整个区域包下来，包到今晚结束。

lines.en: : That’ll be 5,000,000 yen.
: Sure. There should be enough money on this.
lines.zh: : 没问题。这张卡上应该够。

lines.en: : Sorry. I meant 10,000,000. Weekend price.
: This should still be okay.
lines.zh: : 这也还是没问题。

lines.en: scene dndbath2
: How much fucking money can there be in unpoppable bubble wrap?!
lines.zh: : 戳不破的泡泡纸里到底能他妈藏多少钱啊？！

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re okay paying for all of us, Ayane? I can chip in now that I’m a supervisor. I’m no longer poor Rin. I’ve graduated from that and would like to go by financially stable Rin now.
lines.zh: : 你确定要替我们全付吗，Ayane？我现在好歹也是主管了，可以分摊一点。我不再是穷 Rin 了。我已经从那个阶段毕业，现在请叫我财务稳定的 Rin。

lines.en: : Well, financially stable Rin, it’s fine. It’s technically my dad’s money anyway. But hey, if you have your mom’s credit card, we can always make our parents go halfsies!
lines.zh: : 好吧，财务稳定的 Rin，没事的。反正严格来说那是我爸的钱。不过话说回来，你要是带着你妈的信用卡，我们大可以让父母各付一半！

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I make more than my mom. All she does is walk around the school and check on the ropes. That’s all she learned how to do before Sensei left.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定我赚得比我妈多。她整天干的事就是在学校里转悠，检查那些绳子。在 Sensei 离开之前，她学会的就只有这个。

lines.en: : Are they still where they’re supposed to be?
lines.zh: : 它们还在该在的地方吗？

lines.en: : I sure hope so. That’s 50%% of her job.
lines.zh: : 但愿吧。那可是她工作的 50%%。

lines.en: : Will you guys stop loitering and yapping if I just let you in for free?
lines.zh: : 要是我干脆让你们免费进去，你们能不能别再在这儿磨蹭闲扯了？

lines.en: scene dndbath3
: Free? Why? My card is right here.
lines.zh: : 免费？为什么？我卡都掏出来了。

lines.en: : It’s not like anyone else is going to rent it out. Just think of it as a special discount for coming here {i}without{/i} Sensei this time.
lines.zh: : 反正也不会有别人来包场。就当是给这次{i}没带{/i} Sensei 一起来的特别折扣吧。

lines.en: : Is...Is Io doing something {i}nice{/i} for us?
lines.zh: : Io……Io 是在对我们做{i}好事{/i}吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : I think she is, financially stable Rin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她是，财务稳定的 Rin。

lines.en: : I’m not. It’s just a discount. Now please take your financial stability into the bath and leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 我不是。这只是个折扣。现在请把你的财务稳定性带进浴池，别再来烦我了。

lines.en: scene dndbath4
: Whatever it is...thank you, Io. That’s really sweet.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说……谢谢你，Io。真的很贴心。

lines.en: : It’s really not. You’ve rented out the whole thing enough to know the actual price by now.
lines.zh: : 真的一点也不贴心。你们包场过那么多次，现在总该知道实际价格了吧。

lines.en: : I have, yeah. But, could you do me a favor and run this card anyway? For whatever amount you want. I’m pretty sure my dad forgot I exist, so this is my gentle way of reminding him.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我知道。不过，能不能帮我个忙，还是把这张卡刷一下？随便刷多少都行。我敢肯定我爸已经忘了我这个人，所以这是我温柔地提醒他的方式。

lines.en: : When you put it that way, yes.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，行吧。

lines.en: scene black
: That’ll be 5,000,000 yen.
: Here you go. I don’t need a receipt.
lines.zh: : 给你。我不需要收据。

lines.en: : Good, because we don’t have a printer.
lines.zh: : 正好，因为我们没有打印机。

lines.en: : You must really hate your dad, Ayane. That’s a lot of money.
lines.zh: : 你一定很恨你爸吧，Ayane。那可是很大一笔钱。

lines.en: : I am {i}so{/i} fucking tired of smooth jazz, Rin. Ami and Maya are the only ones who understand.
lines.zh: : 我{i}真{/i}是受够轻爵士了，Rin。只有 Ami 和 Maya 懂我。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’ve already lost me. Where are they, by the way? I thought they were gonna meet us here.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你已经把我听丢了。话说她们人呢？我还以为她们要来这儿跟我们碰头。

lines.en: : Sorry. I think I broke your card by trying to put 1,000,000,000 on it. It just keeps getting declined now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我大概是把你的卡刷爆了，我想刷 1,000,000,000 来着。现在一直显示拒付。

lines.en: : Even better. Thanks, Io. And financially stable Rin, Ami and Maya will be here soon. They’re coming from Sensei’s place, so-
lines.zh: : 那就更好了。谢啦，Io。还有财务稳定的 Rin，Ami 和 Maya 很快就到。她们从 Sensei 那边过来，所以——

lines.en: : Sorry. Can you just go back to “Rin” now? All of this “financially stable” stuff is making it feel like I’m bragging.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你能不能改回叫我「Rin」？这些「财务稳定」什么的，让我感觉像是在吹牛。

lines.en: : Can {i}both{/i} of you go back to not being here? I did my part and I would like the yapping to cease now.
lines.zh: : 你们{i}两个{/i}能不能干脆别在这儿？我的那份已经做了，现在我只想让闲扯停下。

lines.en: : Yup! Come on, regular Rin! Come on, everybody else! Let’s all get naked and look at each other!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！走吧，普通版 Rin！其他人也走吧！大家一起脱光光，互相欣赏！

lines.en: scene dndbath5
: Easy for you to say when your body looks like it was sculpted by the gods.
lines.zh: : 你身材像天神雕出来的一样，说这种话当然轻松。

lines.en: : We’re all beautiful in our ways, Rin. I just like seeing all of you blossom into lovely young women.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人都有自己独特的美，Rin。我只是喜欢看着你们一个个绽放成可爱的年轻女人。

lines.en: : For a straight girl, you sure say a lot of really gay stuff.
lines.zh: : 作为一个直女，你说的话可真够弯的。

lines.en: scene dndbath6
: There’s nothing gay about wanting to see your friends naked.
lines.zh: : 想看自己朋友光着身子，哪里弯了。

lines.en: : I’m glad I heard that now and not in middle school or younger Rin would have been even more confused about what was going on in her head.
lines.zh: : 幸好我是现在听到这话，而不是在初中或者更小的时候，不然那时候的 Rin 脑子里会更搞不清状况。

lines.en: : All that matters is that you’re perfect {i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 重要的是，你{i}现在{/i}很完美。

lines.en: : Mhm. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。谢啦。

lines.en: scene dndbath7
: Futaba, do you have any sort of bath plans?
lines.zh: : Futaba，你有什么泡澡计划吗？

lines.en: : What is a “bath plan?”
lines.zh: : 什么是「泡澡计划」？

lines.en: : Like a plan for what you’re going to do in the bath.
lines.zh: : 就是你打算在澡堂里做点什么的计划。

lines.en: : Well, I was really hoping to practice my swimming tonight.
lines.zh: : 那个，我今晚其实很想练练游泳。

lines.en: scene dndbath8
: Damn it. Okay. Never mind then.
lines.zh: : 该死。好吧。那当我没说。

lines.en: : Heeey! Sorry we’re late! Maya only chooses to watch weird, avant garde movies and whatever we watched tonight went on way longer than I thought it would. Bath time!
lines.zh: : 嘿——！抱歉我们来晚了！Maya 就爱挑那种古怪的先锋派电影看，今晚看的那部比我预想的长太多了。泡澡时间！

lines.en: : I regret nothing. Bath time seconded.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不后悔。附议泡澡。

lines.en: : Rin...I’m not actually planning on practicing my swimming tonight. What do you want to ask me?
lines.zh: : Rin……我今晚其实没打算练游泳。你想问什么？

lines.en: scene dndbath9
: Can we talk with, like...just the two of us when we get in? No homo.
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……就是……等进去之后就我们两个聊聊？别误会。

lines.en: : For the millionth time, you don’t need to say “no homo” any time you want to talk to me in the bath and/or shower.
lines.zh: : 我再说第一百万遍，你用不着每次想在浴室或者淋浴间跟我说话的时候都来一句「no homo」。

lines.en: : But that leaves the possibility for me to homo at you when you’re least expecting it.
lines.zh: : 可这样一来，我就有可能在你最意想不到的时候对你「homo」一下。

lines.en: : I don’t think “homo” is a verb.
lines.zh: : 我觉得「homo」不是动词吧。

lines.en: : It is when you’re aggressively bisexual and suck at flirting.
lines.zh: : 对一个激进的双性恋、又完全不会撩的人来说，它就是动词。

lines.en: : Fair. Either way, yes. We can talk. Something specific on your mind?
lines.zh: : 有道理。总之，可以。我们聊聊。你心里有什么具体的事？

lines.en: scene dndbath10
: Poooooossibly?...
: Okay. I think I’ve got a feeling I know what it is then.
lines.zh: : 好。我觉得我心里大概猜到是什么了。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. I’m too cool and mysterious for you to predict something like that.
lines.zh: : 才怪。我这么酷又这么神秘，你不可能猜得到。

lines.en: : Yeah, I definitely know what it is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我绝对知道是什么。

lines.en: scene dndbath11
: No way. You-
lines.zh: : 不可能。你——

lines.en: scene dndbath12
: Dear...{i}God.{/i}
scene dndbath13
: Tsuneyo? She’s beautiful, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？她真美，不是吗？

lines.en: : Close my eyes. I’m about to homo.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼。我要「homo」了。

lines.en: : Feast your eyes upon what can only be referred to as “peak performance,” girls of 1-A.
lines.zh: : 1-A 班的姑娘们，尽情饱览这只能被称为「巅峰之作」的存在吧。

lines.en: : Humble as always, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 还是一如既往地谦逊啊，剑道公主。

lines.en: : Woof.
: Ayane...do you ever think-
lines.zh: : Ayane……你有没有想过——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: scene dndbath14
: I didn’t even say anything yet!
lines.zh: : 我话都还没说呢！

lines.en: : I know. But comparing {i}your{/i} body to Tsuneyo’s will only end in pain. You’re two different types of girls and that’s totally okay!
lines.zh: : 我知道。但拿{i}自己{/i}的身体跟 Tsuneyo 比，最后只会落得一身伤。你们是两种不同类型的女孩，那完全没问题！

lines.en: : I repeat. Woof.
lines.zh: : 我再重复一遍。汪。

lines.en: scene dndbath15
: F...Flat girls are good too! Right, Molly?!
lines.zh: : 平……平胸的女生也很好！对吧，Molly？！

lines.en: : Precisely, Arborea! We need not the endowment of Hera when Aphrodite exists! Assuming that...Hera was more endowed. Which I assume she was because of the whole “fertility” thing.
lines.zh: : 正是，Arborea！既然有阿佛洛狄忒在，我们又何须赫拉的恩赐！前提当然是……赫拉更为丰腴。我猜她应该是，毕竟她管的是「生育」那一摊。

lines.en: : Everyone loves small breasts until their children starve to death from lack of milk.
lines.zh: : 人人都爱小胸，直到他们的孩子因为没奶喝而饿死。

lines.en: : Breast size has nothing to do with milk production, actually. And you can all borrow some of my books on motherhood and childcare if you’d like to confirm that for yourselves.
lines.zh: : 实际上，胸部大小和产奶量毫无关系。你们要是想亲自确认，都可以来找我借几本讲育儿和母婴的书。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Lies. All it takes is common sense to realize there would be no real estate for milk storage in a body like Arborea’s. Xessaxia is clearly the most fit to be a mother here.
lines.zh: : 谎言。只要有点常识就会明白，像 Arborea 那样的身体里根本没地方储存奶水。这里显然 Xessaxia 最适合当母亲。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...no, I...think Ayane is still the most fit out of any of us...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈……不，我……觉得我们这些人里还是 Ayane 最适合……

lines.en: : Have I mentioned “woof” recently? Because-
lines.zh: : 我最近说过「汪」了吗？因为——

lines.en: : We get it! You want the Kendo Princess! We {i}all{/i} do!
lines.zh: : 我们都懂！你想要剑道公主！{i}谁{/i}不想啊！

lines.en: : Futaba, carry me to the bath. I can’t look at her or I’ll cum.
lines.zh: : Futaba，把我抱进浴池吧。我没法再看她了，不然我会高潮的。

lines.en: : Ew! Rin!
lines.zh: : 恶心！Rin！

lines.en: : Just carry me!
lines.zh: : 抱我就对了！

lines.en: scene black
: No! Carry yourself! With your...legs!
lines.zh: : 不要！自己走！用你的……腿！

lines.en: : That’s called “walking,” idiot!
lines.zh: : 那叫「走路」，白痴！

lines.en: : Never fear, Nithhala. I will carry you. It will be just like when I saved the city from the death ball.
lines.zh: : 别怕，Nithhala。我来抱你。就像我从死亡之球手里拯救那座城市时一样。

lines.en: : Don’t compare me to the death ball!!!!!
lines.zh: : 别把我跟死亡之球相提并论！！！！！

lines.en: scene dndbath16
: Hah...I needed this. I’ve been so stressed lately, you don’t even know.
lines.zh: : 哈……我正需要这个。我最近压力太大了，你根本想象不到。

lines.en: : So, are we going to talk about how you’re in love with Sensei {i}now?{/i} Or do you want to soak for a little longer first?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们要不要聊聊你{i}现在{/i}爱上 Sensei 这件事？还是你想再多泡一会儿？

lines.en: scene dndbath17
: I am not!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. What was it you wanted to talk about then?
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。那你本来想聊什么？

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : I need help with our algebra homework!
lines.zh: : 我需要有人辅导我们的代数作业！

lines.en: scene dndbath18
: Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: : Okay, fine! I-
lines.zh: : 好吧，我说！我——

lines.en: : Shh...screaming it at the top of your lungs defeats the purpose of talking alone, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嘘……扯着嗓子喊，那还谈什么悄悄话？

lines.en: scene dndbath19
: Mmm...
: Take your time. We’re not getting kicked out any time soon.
lines.zh: : 慢慢来。我们短时间内不会被赶出去的。

lines.en: : I know...it’s just...
lines.zh: : 我知道……只是……

lines.en: : It’s weird when everyone else notices your feelings before {i}you{/i} do. And ever since you guys all accused me of wanting to {i}fuck{/i} him at the Christmas party, I haven’t been able to stop thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 别人比你{i}自己{/i}先注意到你的感情，这种感觉很奇怪。而且自从你们在圣诞派对上集体指控我想跟他{i}上床{/i}之后，我就再也停不下来想这件事了。

lines.en: : About...{i}specifically{/i} having sex with him? Or your feelings for him in general?
lines.zh: : 想的是……{i}具体{/i}跟他做爱这件事？还是你对他的感情本身？

lines.en: scene dndbath20
: I don’t even {i}know.{/i} That’s the problem.
lines.zh: : 我自己都不{i}知道{/i}。问题就在这儿。

lines.en: : Like, you’re obviously my {i}best{/i} friend. But Sensei is my “best” friend. My homie.
lines.zh: : 你看，你显然是我{i}最好{/i}的朋友。但 Sensei 是我「最」好的朋友。我的老铁。

lines.en: : He’s been with me through practically everything since high school started and, do I frequently imagine his penis inside of me? Yes. But should I {i}receive{/i} said penis? Absolutely not. No way. Nuh uh.
lines.zh: : 从高中开学到现在，几乎什么事他都在我身边，而我确实经常幻想他的阴茎在我里面吗？是的。但我该真的{i}得到{/i}那根阴茎吗？绝对不。不可能。想都别想。

lines.en: : I just can’t stop thinking about him.
lines.zh: : 我只是没办法不去想他。

lines.en: : You’ve always done that, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你一直都这样啊，Rin。

lines.en: : Get penised? I certainly have not. Not by anyone real, at least. Even Otoha only used her hands and mouth and-
lines.zh: : 一直想被「上」？我当然没有。至少没被任何真实的人上过。连 Otoha 也只用过手和嘴，还有——

lines.en: : I...do not need to know the details of that. What I meant was that you always get hung up on whoever you’re currently into. And right now, that person is obviously Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我……不需要知道那些细节。我的意思是，你向来会对当下迷恋的人死缠烂打。而现在，那个人显然是 Sensei。

lines.en: : But it {i}shouldn’t{/i} be. He’s {i}old.{/i} That’s {i}weird.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可{i}不该{/i}是他啊。他那么{i}老{/i}。太{i}怪{/i}了。

lines.en: : You do realize you’re speaking to someone who has been “penised” by him many times, right?
lines.zh: : 你应该意识到，你现在说话的对象，可是被他「上」过很多次的人吧？

lines.en: scene dndbath21
: Yeah! So why are you being {i}supportive{/i} of me right now? Isn’t this a major betrayal? And not just to {i}you{/i} either. To Chika. Ayane. Ami. Everyone {i}else{/i} who loves him.
lines.zh: : 对啊！那你为什么还要{i}支持{/i}我？这不算是天大的背叛吗？而且不只是对{i}你{/i}。对 Chika。对 Ayane。对 Ami。对每一个爱他的人。

lines.en: : Why can’t I just like Uta or Kirin or something? That’d be so much easier.
lines.zh: : 我为什么就不能喜欢 Uta 或者 Kirin 什么的？那样会轻松多了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s not how it works. And I don’t think of it as a betrayal at all. I’ve never for a second imagined being exclusive with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可事情不是这么运作的。而且我一点都不觉得这是背叛。我从来没想过要和 Sensei 一对一独占。

lines.en: : Futaba. Come on.
lines.zh: : Futaba。拜托。

lines.en: scene dndbath22
: Okay, sorry. What I {i}meant{/i} to say was I never imagined such a thing would be {i}possible.{/i} Not with someone like me at least.
lines.zh: : 好吧，抱歉。我{i}想说{/i}的是，我从来没想过那种事有{i}可能{/i}成真。至少对象是像我这样的人时不会。

lines.en: : I really don’t like it when you say things like that. You’re the most beautiful, amazing person I’ve ever met and Sensei would be lucky to have you.
lines.zh: : 我真的不喜欢你说这种话。你是我见过最漂亮、最了不起的人，Sensei 能得到你是他的福气。

lines.en: scene dndbath23
: He’d be lucky to have {i}you{/i} too. And if you actually have feelings for him, I think you’re better off acting on them rather than just giving everyone else a shot instead.
lines.zh: : 他能得到{i}你{/i}也是福气。如果你真的对他有感觉，我觉得你不如顺着心意去做，总好过把其他所有人都试一遍。

lines.en: : {i}Maybe.{/i} But there’s the fear of fucking things up too. I don’t want to ruin the relationship I already have with him because it’s...honestly, one of the best things that’s ever happened to me.
lines.zh: : {i}也许吧。{/i}但我也怕把事情搞砸。我不想毁掉我现在和他之间的关系，因为它……老实说，是我这辈子发生过的最好的事之一。

lines.en: scene dndbath24
: Which is...embarrassing and...weird to say about a guy who’s over twice my age. But it’s the truth. So maybe it’s best if I just...you know...keep waiting. For someone {i}else{/i} to catch my eye.
lines.zh: : 而对着一个大我两倍多的男人说出这种话……又丢人又……奇怪。可那就是事实。所以也许我最好还是……你知道的……继续等下去。等{i}别人{/i}来吸引我的目光。

lines.en: : Well, do you think you’re capable of that now that your feelings are out in the open? Or do you think you’re going to cave and confess to him on the beach like you have with your past two love interests?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得，如今你的感情已经摊开在阳光下了，你还做得到吗？还是说你会像前两次恋爱那样，在海滩上投降告白？

lines.en: : I doubt I’ll last until the beach if a confession is coming. I literally can {i}not{/i} stop thinking about him lately. It’s almost as bad as I was with Chika. My poor vibrator is going to explode.
lines.zh: : 要是真要告白，我怀疑自己撑不到海滩。我最近真的没办法{i}不{/i}去想他。简直快赶上我迷 Chika 那会儿了。我可怜的振动棒快要爆炸了。

lines.en: : Again, don’t need details like that.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这种细节我真的不需要。

lines.en: scene dndbath25

: Well, you’re getting them because I don’t know who else to talk to about this. So yeah, stress level — infinite. Love sucks. Being a teenager sucks. I can’t wait until I’m older and don’t have to deal with all these hormones.
lines.zh: : 可你还是会听到，因为我不知道还能跟谁说这些。所以没错，压力等级——无限。恋爱真讨厌。当青少年真讨厌。我巴不得快点长大，不用再应付这些荷尔蒙。

lines.en: : If you think getting older is going to stop you from being so horny, I’d urge you to take another look at the person you’re falling for this time and see what that’s done for {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果你以为长大就不会这么饥渴了，我劝你再好好看看这次让你沦陷的那个人，看看长大都把{i}他{/i}变成了什么样子。

lines.en: : Please. The last thing I need is more thoughts about him and being horny. Especially when I’m already surrounded by boobs and ready to explode.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我最不需要的就是关于他和发情的更多念头。尤其现在我周围全是胸部，随时都要炸了。

lines.en: : Just fuck him already.
lines.zh: : 干脆直接上了他吧。

lines.en: scene dndbath26
: Futaba! What the heck?! You’re supposed to be my voice of reason, not the horny devil on my shoulder!
lines.zh: : Futaba！你搞什么？！你应该是我的理性之声，而不是我肩上的色情小恶魔！

lines.en: : I’m sorry! It’s just...hahah!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！只是……哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene dndbath27
: You’re one of what I can only assume is a very small group of girls in our class who {i}hasn’t{/i} yet. It doesn’t hurt to give it a shot.
lines.zh: : 在我们班上，我猜{i}还没{/i}跟他做过的女生应该只剩很小一撮了，而你就是其中之一。试一试又不会少块肉。

lines.en: : But you specifically told me it {i}did{/i} hurt when he did it with you.
lines.zh: : 可你{i}明明{/i}跟我说过，他跟你做的时候很疼。

lines.en: : Well...physically, yes. He is...{i}large.{/i} But emotionally, it-
lines.zh: : 嗯……生理上，是的。他很……{i}大{/i}。但情感上，那——

lines.en: scene dndbath28
: Actually...it has the potential to be very emotionally painful too considering that...I imagine you want him all to yourself, so...
lines.zh: : 其实……情感上也有可能相当痛苦，考虑到……我想你是想独占他吧，所以……

lines.en: : So basically, I’m just fucked. And I’m fucked by literally {i}not{/i} being fucked. Which is like the worst possible way to be fucked out of all the fucking ways to be fucked.
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，我是彻底完蛋了。而我的完蛋，恰恰是因为{i}没{/i}被上。在所有该死的完蛋方式里，这大概是最烂的一种完蛋法。

lines.en: scene dndbath29
: Yeah, basically.
lines.zh: : 是啊，基本可以这么说。

lines.en: : But hey, at least you have your vibrator.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，至少你还有振动棒。

lines.en: scene dndbath30
: Mmm...
: At the end of the day, I think it’s important that you act on your feelings rather than trying to hide them for the sake of your friends.
lines.zh: : 说到底，我觉得重要的是你顺着自己的感情去行动，而不是为了朋友把它们藏起来。

lines.en: : But of course, that’s just {i}my{/i} stance. And I imagine Chika is the one you’re the most terrified of right now given how close you two have become and...how scary she just...naturally {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然，这只是{i}我的{/i}立场。而且我想，现在你最怕的人应该是 Chika，毕竟你们俩变得那么亲近，再加上她……天生就那么吓人。

lines.en: : Pbrlblrblrlblrblrll....
lines.zh: : 噗噜噜噜噜……

lines.en: : I have no idea what you just tried to say. But I know you well enough to assume it was something else about how you’re mostly just afraid of ruining something.
lines.zh: : 我完全没听懂你刚才想说什么。但我足够了解你，可以断定那无非又是些「你多半只是怕毁掉什么」之类的话。

lines.en: : Pbrlbrl...
lines.zh: : 噗噜噜……

lines.en: : Well...again, this is just the way I see things...but I don’t think that’s avoidable, Rin. I think you’re going to wind up hurting someone one way or another no matter {i}how{/i} desperately you try to avoid it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……再说一遍，这只是我看事情的方式……但我觉得那是躲不掉的，Rin。不管你{i}多{/i}拼命想避免，到头来你总会以某种方式伤到某个人。

lines.en: : Doing things for yourself isn’t always selfish. Sometimes, it’s what {i}needs{/i} to be done if you want to make any progress.
lines.zh: : 为自己做事并不总是自私。有时候，如果你想有任何进展，那就{i}非做不可{/i}。

lines.en: : And if you ever feel like you’re stuck, it’s fine to chalk that up to being young and indecisive. Like, who knows? Maybe in ten years, this will be something the two of us will look back at and laugh about.
lines.zh: : 而如果你什么时候觉得自己卡住了，那大可以把它归咎于年轻和优柔寡断。话说，谁知道呢？也许十年后，这会变成我们俩回头看时会一笑而过的事。

lines.en: : But if, right now, you’re thinking “I hope he’s still with me ten years from now,” that’s never going to happen if you don’t act.
lines.zh: : 但如果此刻你心里在想「我希望十年后他还在我身边」，那你要是不行动，就永远不会有那一天。

lines.en: : Pblrlblrlblrl........
lines.zh: : 噗噜噜噜噜……

lines.en: : I still have no idea what you’re trying to say.
lines.zh: : 我还是没听懂你想说什么。

lines.en: scene dndbath31

lines.zh: : 你们好。翡翠守护者这副虚弱的欧洲人体质，迫使她先从水里撤退了。请问我可以加入你们，一起把 Nithhala 溺死吗？

lines.en: And while the answers she received were not technically the ones she wanted, they {i}did{/i} help her confirm one thing.
